;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[2019 Reyhanlı car bombing]]
**A [[car bomb]] explodes in the [[Turkey|Turkish]] city of [[Reyhanlı]]. The blast kills three [[Syria]]n citizens who were inside the car. [https://www.dailysabah.com/turkey/2019/07/05/car-explodes-in-reyhanli-town-center-in-southern-turkeys-hatay-cause-unknown (''Daily Sabah'')]
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–present)|War in Afghanistan]]
**Fourteen civilians are killed and 45 injured in mortar attacks in [[Faryab Province]]. Taliban insurgents claim responsibility for the attack. [https://www.tolonews.com/afghanistan/taliban%E2%80%99s-rocket-attacks-faryab-kill-four-civilians-police (TOLOnews)]
**A bomb hits a [[mosque]] in [[Ghazni]], [[Afghanistan]], killing two and wounding over 40. [https://www.tolonews.com/afghanistan/blast-ghazni-mosque-leaves-two-dead (TOLOnews)]

;Arts and culture
*[[Hijab by country]]
**[[Tunisia|Tunisian]] [[Head of Government of Tunisia|Prime Minister]] [[Youssef Chahed]] announces that the [[niqab]] will be banned in public institutions effective immediately, citing security concerns following [[2019 Tunis bombings|a pair of suicide bombings]] on June 27. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/07/tunisia-bans-face-veils-public-institutions-bombing-190705132559010.html (Al Jazeera)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2019 Ridgecrest earthquakes]]
**A magnitude 7.1 earthquake hits Southern California just a day after a magnitude 6.4 earthquake in the same area. [https://earthquake.usgs.gov/earthquakes/eventpage/ci38457511/executive (USGS)]
*Seven Americans, including coal billionaire [[Chris Cline]], are found dead in a helicopter crash in [[the Bahamas]]. [https://www.latimes.com/business/la-fi-chris-cline-killed-helicopter-crash-bahamas-20190705-story.html (''Los Angeles Times'')]

;Politics and elections
*[[Operation Car Wash]]
**New text messages between [[Brazil]]ian judge [[Sérgio Moro]] and Operation Car Wash's prosecutors are leaked by ''[[The Intercept|The Intercept Brasil]]'' and ''[[Veja (magazine)|Veja]]''. In the messages, Judge Moro illegally advises the prosecutors in including pieces of evidence against defendants of cases presided by him and suggests dates for [[Federal Police of Brazil|Federal Police]] operations. The messages also suggest that Moro withheld evidence to prevent cases being transferred out of his jurisdiction to the [[Supreme Federal Court]]. [https://veja.abril.com.br/politica/dialogos-veja-capa-intercept-moro-dallagnol/ (''Veja'')]
*[[2018–19 Sudanese protests|Sudanese protests]]
**The [[Sudanese military]] and representatives of civil groups agree on a deal to share power for a transition period. [https://www.dw.com/en/sudan-military-and-opposition-agree-on-power-sharing-deal/a-49479620 (DW)]
